To all my unpaid PR managers working overtime in the cafeteria... thank you for the free promotion! 💅 I hope my life's drama is keeping your boring 9-to-5 exciting. 🤪 Keep talking, you're making me famous. 👻

Tag that one work friend who always has the tea! 💣

If playing the victim card was an Olympic sport, sweetie, you’d have a gold medal by now. 💅 Stop acting like the main character in a movie you aren't even auditioned for. 💣 Tag that one drama queen who needs this reality check today! 🤪👻

#RealityCheck #DramaQueens #HinglishSarcasm #SavageReplies #SorryNotSorry

Sorry not sorry that my facts don't come with a side of sugar! 💅 If you wanted sweet talk, you should have ordered a donut 🤪 Some people get offended so easily when you don't wrap the truth in a pretty gift box 👻 My filter broke years ago and honestly, I'm not fixing it 💣

Tag that brutally honest friend who always speaks facts! 👇

#SavageFacts #SorryNotSorry #HinglishSarcasm #RelatableReels #TruthHurts

To all the toxic relatives and nosy neighbours who think they are the directors of my life... sorry, but the show is permanently cancelled! 💅 Apni drama script apne paas hi rakho, yahan audience zero hai. 🤪👻

Drop a 💣 in the comments if you have mastered the art of ignoring unwanted opinions!

#SavageHinglish #NoTimeForDrama #ToxicRelatives #SassyQuotes #RelatableReels

Please, keep your free advice to yourself, my life is already fully booked with peace! 💅 Send this to that one relative who always asks 'shaadi kab hai?' 🤪 Let them know you're busy living your best life 💣.
